book.name: 2 Timocheyo
book.title: Baluwa jhuubhele jha Pauli kwa Timocheyo

content: Nkomana ngondo jwa kuhobholeka jwa Yecho Kilichitu
Bhahe, mwe ma mwanango Timocheyo, mma na makakala mu umbone ghitupatite mu kulombana na Kilichitu Yecho.
Na mabholo ghunyohina nikatangacha palonge jha bhando twe, gheniya mabhola bhando bhibhahobholeka na bheniya bhihoto kwabhola bhando bhange.
Mwe nhimbilila malagho pamonga na nenga ngita nkomana ngondo jwaumbone jwa Kilichitu Yecho.
Nkomana ngondo jwabhii kungondo ihenga jhe mahengo gha ughome gwa kila lichiko nambo ihenga mahengo gha kungondo, kupala kunhalalicha nkolongwa jwa akakomana ngondo.
Helahela kwa mundo jhojhoha jwailongocha pumubhutuka mbelo ihoto jhe kupata hupo jha kubhutuka changakengama malaghalikilo ghighabhekwitwe.
Jwalema hake ipalwa atumbula kupata mahuno.
Mughabheka umwojho gheniya ghinilonge, nhwalo Bhambo nantenda umanya ghanga ghoha.
Munkomboka Kilichitu Yecho, jwayokichwe kuhumii mukuwegha, jwahumi mulukolo lwa Daude, ngita chililonge Lilobhe lya Mbone linitangacha.
Kwa nhwalo gwenio ne ning'ahika na ndabhitwe minyololo ngita namwiye. Nambo Lilobhe lya Mbone lya Chapanga litabhwa jhe minyololo.

Kwa yenio nihimbilii kila kilebhe ku nhwalo gwa bhando bhibhahaghulilwe na Chapanga, na bheniya hele bhapata ukomboche ghubhii nkate jha Kilichitu Yecho na kuleta ung'alicho gwa machiko ghoha ghangapeta.
Lilobhe lende ndi la uchakaka,
Nhenga lihengo jwajheketilwe na Chapanga

Bhahe, makombocha bhando bhino mihalo jhenje na kwakelebhuya palonge jha Chapanga bhakotoka kung'aulana kwa malobhe ghanganandela. Mitaho jhene ihalalii jhe, nhwalo kilebhe chenie chahobhecha bhibhajhokanikiya.
Nkachane kuhenga ilebhe ihalalii Chapanga, mme maunhenga mahengo mambone jwangaikole hone lihengo lyake na kone abhola telatela malobhe gheniya gha chakaka gwa Chapanga.
Mme kutale na mihalo jha undindilima na jhangahalalii Chapanga, nhwalo jhene ujhendelele kwabheka bhando bhabhehe kutale na Chapanga.
Mabholo ngita gheniya ghiwanana ngita mabhanga ndela ghangalama lililye yegha. Pakate jha bhando jwabholita ilebhe yenio ndi Humeneyo na Fileto.
Bheniya bhailekite kutale ndela jha uchakaka, na ndi bhihangabhana kihobholelo cha bhando bhange kukulonge uyokecho kwa bhando bhoha upetite.

Nambo nchinge ghuchengwitwe na Chapanga ujhemite nganganga. Na panane jhake ghajhandikwe ghanga, “Bhambo abhamanya bhando bhake,” na “Kila mundo jwalonge jwenie ndi jwa Bhambo, ndi alekane na uhakaho.”
Munyumba ngolongwa ibhii jhe yombo ya madine gha feza na chaabo tugha nambo ibhii yombo ya mikongo na undope henge itopela na yangatopela.

Anda mundo akijhelehwiye na kubhehe kutale na yombo yenio yangatopela nabhaha chombu cha kuhenge mahengo gha kanjika, nhwalo akipihite na kutumika na Bhambo na akilenganikiye kuhenga kila lihengo lilibhii lyambone.
Mukibhambaye na tama mboho ya ungombo na ntame tela ngita chapala Chapanga, na mme kihobholelo na upalo na uteeke pamonga na bhando bhoha bhibhannyopa Bhambo kwa mwojho gwamaha.
Mukibhambaye na mitau jhanganandela na jha umbebhebhe, mabhene umanya kuhenga yenio kwileta bhulo.
Ntumiche jwa Bhambo akomana jhe, ipalwa abhaha jwanuu kwa bhando bhoha, jwahoto kubhola na kuhimbilila,
jwanuu pakelebhuya bhando bhibhakomana, nhwalo bheniya Chapanga ahoto kwaghalambula na kuuleka uhakaho gwabhe na kuumanya uchakaka.
Peniya, malango ghabhe ghabhujhii kabhele, na kupokonyoka muntambo gwa Jwanganandela jwabhajhonjite na kwatenda bhatende chapala jwenio.
